boundary_condition: This default only applies to the airline/carrier field; it does not set destination, travel dates, route, cabin, price, or departure time.
condition: When searching for or booking flights and airline choice is open among otherwise viable options, with no explicit request for a different carrier.
default_action: Prioritize and select an American Airlines flight when it satisfies the requested itinerary constraints.
exception_condition: Do not force American Airlines if it is unavailable for the required itinerary, fails a hard schedule or route constraint, or the user explicitly asks for another airline.
name: Prefer American Airlines when choosing flights
preference_value: American Airlines as the preferred flight carrier
rationale: The cited independent flight-task sources repeatedly name American Airlines in the airline slot, including one explicit preference, and none cite a competing carrier. This supports a controlled synthetic default for carrier selection without treating the speakers as one real longitudinal user.
